info.name: Channel Connect - SMS API
info.description: Only SMS send and receive requests against Channel Connect. Set smsApiToken to SMS_API_TOKEN, edit recipient directly in the send request JSON body, and set accountId to the configured SIM for send and new-message polling. Receive-all lists retained application inbox history across configured SIMs; optionally add accountId or sender. It returns bounded pages: set inboxCursor manually to nextCursor for the next page when hasMore=true; leave it at 0 to keep viewing the start of the inbox. It never advances automatically. receiveCursor is separate and tracks new-message polling. The local inbox contains messages retained by Channel Connect. Add sms-own-receive after sms-http or sms-http-api to receive directly from GoIP through this application, without smsgateway polling. Configure the gateway SMS-server destination to the application UDP address/port and matching per-SIM credentials; see docs/goip-sms.md. Historic messages held only by the remote gateway are unavailable through this mode. 202 means queued, not delivered.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get("smsApiToken")) throw new Error("Set smsApiToken to SMS_API_TOKEN.");
pm.test("SMS accepted for queueing", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); });

if (pm.response.code === 202) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Submission has messageId and status", function () { pm.expect(body.messageId).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(body.status).to.be.a("string"); }); pm.collectionVariables.set("messageId", body.messageId); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Inbox page includes messages and hasMore", function () { pm.expect(body.messages).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(body.hasMore).to.be.a("boolean"); }); }
